content_sections.heading: ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out
content_sections.text: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Department of Space, Government of India, has released the ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB) for 92 Scientist/Engineer 'SC' vacancies across multiple engineering disciplines. The notification includes complete details about post-wise vacancies, eligibility, GATE paper codes, salary, age limit, application fee, selection process, and important dates. Eligible candidates with a valid GATE score can apply online until 17 August 2026. Candidates can use the direct link below to download the official notification PDF and read all recruitment details. Download ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026 Employment Notification Official Website: www.isro.gov.in

faq.question: Q1. Is the ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification out?
faq.answer: Yes. ISRO, through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB), has released the notification for 92 vacancies of Scientist/Engineer 'SC', with online registration open until 17-08-2026

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 92 vacancies are available across Electronics (34), Mechanical (26), Computer Science (13), Civil (10, plus 1 in Autonomous Body PRL), Electrical (4), Refrigeration & Air Conditioning (2), and Architecture (2).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 17-08-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as on 17-08-2026. Age relaxation for applicable categories is detailed in the website advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for ISRO Scientist/Engineer 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is made purely on the basis of the candidate's valid GATE score in the relevant paper code for the post applied for.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of ISRO Scientist/Engineer 'SC'?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are placed in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix with a minimum basic pay of ₹56,100 per month, plus DA, HRA, and Transport Allowance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹250 per application, payable online via the Bharatkosh portal. Women, SC/ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. Which post has the highest vacancies in this ISRO recruitment?
faq.answer: The Electronics post (BE001) has the highest number of vacancies at 34, followed by Mechanical (BE002) with 26.

faq.question: Q9. Which GATE paper codes are accepted for ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GATE paper codes EC (Electronics), ME (Mechanical), CS (Computer Science), CE (Civil), EE (Electrical), and AR (Architecture) are accepted, depending on the post applied for.
